disposition: one victim wounded; ambulance responded; no suspect description available
summary: Units were sent to a shooting southeast of Bakersfield just after 1:30 a.m., where dispatchers relayed that one victim had a gunshot wound to the arm and that there was no suspect description. An ambulance was routed to the scene and units were given the go-ahead to enter. Crews working the call also reported a gas leak inside the structure, and other units were started toward the scene to stage.

area: senior living complex, Brookside Drive area, Bakersfield
disposition: smoke investigated; main breaker shut down; crews remained on scene
summary: Engines, a truck and a battalion were sent to a senior living complex in the Brookside Drive area after a burnt smell coming from two vents and a fog of smoke inside one of the buildings were reported. Crews reported smoke inside the structure and worked the building, asking that the main breaker for the condenser unit on the east side be shut down while they investigated. About 50 to 60 vehicles remained parked in the lot during the response.

area: 21st Street at Chester Avenue, downtown Bakersfield
disposition: suspect returned to the scene; disturbance still ongoing
summary: Downtown units were sent to a strong-arm robbery at 21st Street and Chester Avenue. The person reporting the robbery said a phone was taken from her, and the suspect briefly left in a black SUV before coming back to the scene, where the argument was still going as officers arrived.

disposition: multiple units sent; weapons unknown; fire crews canceled from the call
summary: Deputies were sent to a park area in the county for a disturbance reported to involve about 20 juveniles with unknown weapons and several subjects arguing near the park. A fire engine that had been started toward the call was canceled.

area: 10500 block of Meacham Road, Kern County
disposition: suspect still outstanding; deputies handling the report
summary: Deputies were called to a kidnapping report in the 10500 block of Meacham Road. The person reporting told dispatchers the juveniles involved had gone missing again after entering through a side entrance of the property, and the suspect was still outstanding.

Units took a report of a missing 6-year-old girl last seen near the kids' carnival, wearing a pink cowboy T-shirt. Deputies were also told that a subject they were looking for was part of a missing juvenile case out of the agency.

disposition: units sent on a priority welfare check
summary: A priority welfare check in the 4500 block of Columbus Street turned into a report of someone on the hood of a car while the driver moved the vehicle backward, trying to throw her off. Units were sent to the location.

Deputies were sent to a domestic violence report in the Park Drive area, where a caller said a man 52 years old had kicked her in the ribs and punched her in the face. The caller reported the man was in an RV on the property, and dispatchers passed a description of him to responding units.

area: east of a golf course, Kern County
disposition: crews working on access; no structure involved at that point
summary: Crews reported they could see what looked like a fire east of a golf course and were working to make access. The man who reported it had already left the area.
A two-vehicle collision was reported on northbound Interstate 5 just south of Highway 58.

area: traffic signal, city yard area, Bakersfield
disposition: street crew requested; light hanging by its wires
summary: A traffic light that had come loose and was hanging by its wires at an intersection drew a call to city crews. Dispatch clarified that the damaged signal was one of the traffic lights at the intersection, not a street light on the pole.

A caller reported a man in his 30s or 40s sitting or standing in the roadway in the 500 block of East 19th Street and said drivers had nearly hit him. The caller, waiting nearby, reported the man's head was sweaty and that he was not responding.
A German shepherd was reported running loose around the neighborhood in the Sacramento Street area.

area: 6000 block of Auburn Oaks Drive, Kern County
summary: A welfare check in the 6000 block of Auburn Oaks Drive was upgraded for a faster response after dispatchers learned the person involved was the caller's husband and was reported not to be making suicidal statements. A description was passed to units.

disposition: translator requested to clarify the call
summary: Crews were sent to the 400 block of Shattuck Avenue for an unknown medical aid and requested a translator to get further details.

disposition: patient care handed to medical units
summary: A medical aid was dispatched to the 1000 block of 19th Street, suite level, for a person having difficulty breathing.
An engine was assigned to a medical aid in the McArthur Drive area, with a county unit pending on the call.

area: south Chester Avenue on-ramp to eastbound Highway 58
disposition: vehicle disabled on the embankment; traffic control notified
summary: A vehicle was reported on the embankment along the south Chester Avenue on-ramp to the eastbound Highway 58 and was unable to move. Dispatchers were asked to notify the appropriate control channel and a tow was requested.

area: 6700 block of Eucalyptus Drive, Kern County
disposition: one RP an employee, two clients present; description limited
summary: Deputies were sent to the 6700 block of Eucalyptus Drive for a report involving a possible weapon. The person reporting was an employee at the location where two clients were present, and no further description of the person involved was available.
